title: Canonical derived pullback tensor comparison in K-flat coordinates
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Define the canonical map $\tau_g(E,K):Lg^*(E\otimes^L K)\to Lg^*E\otimes^L Lg^*K$ for all $E,K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$. The family is natural in both derived inputs. It is the map determined on every pair of K-flat representatives $P,N$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] by the following equation. Write $\mu_X(P,N):Q(P)\otimes^L Q(N)\to Q(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N))$ for the canonical localization tensor comparison [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and $\epsilon_g(P):Lg^*Q(P)\to Q(g^*P)$ for the shared left-derived counit [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], using the actual termwise module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $\phi_g(P,N):g^*\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(g^*P\otimes g^*N)$ be the chain isomorphism whose map on the summand $P^p\otimes N^q$ is precisely the canonical module pullback tensor isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], followed by the target summand inclusion. Then $Lg^*(\mu_X(P,N));\epsilon_g(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes N));Q(\phi_g(P,N))=\tau_g(Q(P),Q(N));(\epsilon_g(P)\otimes\epsilon_g(N));\mu_T(g^*P,g^*N)$. Choose the comparison supplied by this equation. K-flat resolutions and their universal comparison maps make it independent of representatives. This is the canonical isomorphism of [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product], now as a named map on the recorded derived tensor objects.
